'''Chapter 749''' is titled "March Forward!! Army of Rascals".

==Cover Page==
Cover Page Request: "[[Curly Dadan|Dadan]] dreaming of [[Sabo]] and the Others" - from Maru x Kazu, Miyagi Prefecture.

==Short Summary==
After [[Pica]]'s arm was destroyed by [[Chinjao]] and [[Elizabello II]], the [[Corrida Colosseum|Colosseum]] fighters proceed to decimate the [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]] soldiers. But Pica was not out of the fight and attacked again with his remaining arm, throwing the fighters in disarray. The fighters then noticed that [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is missing and one of them sees Luffy riding [[Ucy]] while climbing the colossus arm toward the giant head. Pica noticed this and [[Ishi Ishi no Mi|grew his arm back]], before going to strike his attacker, but Luffy was ready and breaks the giant's head off with a [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear Third Moves|Grizzly Magnum]]. Pica was then revealed to be controlling the colossus from within, and prepares to cut Luffy down with a huge sword, but [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] intercepts it and stays behind to duel Pica while Luffy races toward Doflamingo's palace.

[[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]], who was still with Luffy was deep in thought and decided to reveal some secrets of his past. Thirteen years ago, his benefactor [[Donquixote Rosinante|Corazon]] was killed by Doflamingo and was not only a top executive of the [[Donquixote Family]], but was Doflamingo's brother.

==Long Summary==
The citizens of [[Dressrosa]] are shocked to see [[Pica]]'s arm crumble apart after [[Chinjao]]'s and [[Elizabello II]]'s attack, and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], in a panic, rides [[Ucy]] away from the falling rubble. The soldiers on the streets attempt to stop the [[Corrida Colosseum|Colosseum]] fighters, but are thwarted by [[Ideo]], who uses Destruction Cannon to blow the shocked soldiers away. [[Orlumbus]] and [[Cavendish]] join in, respectively using the moves Admiral's Hug and Swan Lake. The soldiers are powerless to stop them, but Pica gears up for another assault on the fighters. Chinjao prepares to hold the [[Donquixote Pirates|Donquixote]] executive off, but [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] sees that Pica's severed arm has grown back, and, knowing that continuing fighting like this would be useless, shouts at everybody to run.

The fighters run away from Pica's second attack, which destroys more of Dressrosa, and the fighters are at a loss on how to get through Pica to Doflamingo's castle. Suddenly, Cavendish notices that Luffy isn't with them, and the fighters are incredibly shocked to see the Straw Hat riding Ucy up Pica's arm. Luffy heads up excitedly, and [[Abdullah]] and [[Jeet]], having also hitched a ride on Ucy, also cheer, which causes Luffy to realize they are there and to yell at them to get off. Pica then notices Luffy, and in silent rage grows his arm back, preparing to attack the pirate. Luffy attacks him first, however, hitting Pica in the face with [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear Third Moves|Gomu Gomu no Grizzly Magnum]]. The attack shatters Pica's face and shocks the fighters and citizens down below.

Zoro, having ridden on Ucy with Luffy, points out that Pica's shattered arm and head were just pure stone, and that Pica's real body was located where his fake head was. Zoro remarks that Pica is finally showing some human characteristics, when the Donquixote executive pulls out a giant sword, scaring Abdullah and Jeet. They beg Ucy to turn around or stop, but the bull cannot do either of those things as Pica swings at it. However, Luffy manages to get underneath Ucy and propel it upward, out of the sword's path. Ucy lands behind Pica, but the executive officer quickly turns around, preparing to strike again. Thankfully, Zoro manages to counter his blow with one sword, which causes a shocked Abdullah and Jeet to call him and Luffy "comrades of god". Pica tells Zoro to get out of the way so he can deal with Luffy, but Zoro says that Luffy has no business with a chunk of stone like him and mocks his high-pitched voice, enraging Pica further.

The fighters below notice that Pica's stone body has frozen, and take advantage of this to head for [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]]'s castle, intent on his head. Luffy, Abdullah, and Jeet continue riding away from Pica, the latter two refusing to get off despite Luffy's demands. Suddenly, [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] snaps out of his thought, admitting to Luffy that his plan had been a detour to crush Doflamingo, but that he, too, wanted to repay the [[Shichibukai]] after losing to him before. He then tells Luffy how Doflamingo took away the most important person to him 13 years ago. This person was [[Donquixote Rosinante|Corazon]], his benefactor and the former top executive of the Donquixote family, as well as Doflamingo's true brother. 

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], still aboard the [[Ucy]], presses on towards the Royal Palace. [[Abdullah]] and [[Jeet]] are still tagging along. 
*[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] has learned the inner workings of [[Pica]]'s [[Ishi Ishi no Mi|Devil Fruit ability]] to an extent due to their earlier, unseen confrontation at the Royal Palace.
*Zoro has a rematch with Pica.
*Pica's weapon of choice, a huge sword, is shown for the first time.
*Pica's larger stone body has ceased movement while his more human-like form engages Zoro.
*[[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] admits that there were inefficiencies in his initial plan, and still aims to take Doflamingo's head.
*[[Donquixote Rosinante|Corazon]] is revealed to be Doflamingo's younger brother and Law's benefactor.
*Doflamingo murdered his brother Corazon, who was at the time a top executive of the [[Donquixote Family]].
